generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Improve capsules from runtime evidence, validate candidates, and promote or roll back versions.

contract.purpose_user_function: Use evaluation evidence to propose and gate improved capability versions, then promote or roll back approved changes.
contract.valid_inputs: Capability scorecards, failures/events, candidate version/patch, evaluation pack, regression result, and approval decision.
contract.expected_outputs: Recommendation, evaluation evidence, promotion/demotion status, evolution event, or rollback indication.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes scorecard/evolution rows and may update promoted skill/capability artifacts through dedicated evolution tooling.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Failed evaluation/regression, missing evidence, policy rejection, low score, or unavailable candidate blocks promotion; unsafe silent rewrite is outside the approved flow.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Generic scorecard/promotion controls and skill evolution exist; end-to-end capsule migration/version rollback as one transaction was not found.
contract.success_evidence: Versioned candidate and before/after evidence must be persisted and promotion must require eval plus regression gates. The former stateful shell probes are quarantined pending a fully isolated runtime fixture.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: candidate generation; evaluation pass/fail; regression pass/fail; approval required; promotion; demotion/rollback; unchanged version on failure.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow; docs/solar-architecture-code-map.md §7 Capability capsules; docs/CAPSULE_ARCHITECTURE.md §§2-6
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/capability_capsules.py: load_capability_capsule_registry(), validate_capability_capsule(), query_capability_capsules(), resolve_capability_capsule_for_task(); harness/lib/capability_registry.py CLI main() with sync/list/query/scorecard
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/evolution_engine.py: scorecard(), promote(), demote_degraded(), run_loop(); harness/tools/skill_evolution_runner.py: run_once()
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Manifest validation is local and cross-platform Python; actual bindings can require provider credentials, installed skills, MCP services, browser/CLI sessions, or host-specific runtimes.

implementation.entrypoints: harness/lib/evolution_engine.py: scorecard(), promote(), demote_degraded(), run_loop(); harness/tools/skill_evolution_runner.py: run_once()
implementation.interfaces: harness/lib/capability_capsules.py: load_capability_capsule_registry(), validate_capability_capsule(), query_capability_capsules(), resolve_capability_capsule_for_task(); harness/lib/capability_registry.py CLI main() with sync/list/query/scorecard
